reviews.author: Tom S.
reviews.quote: Quick to respond, fair price, explained the work clearly. job well done. John took care of the hole in the ceiling and cleaned up after. Thank you. Definitely will call again if there's a need for plastering job.
reviews.analysis: Closest finish-side task evidence in wave 6: a hole in a ceiling was made good by this business, with the work explained beforehand and the site cleaned afterwards. It does not say what created the hole, whether plumbing was involved, whether an access panel was framed, or how the texture was matched.

reviews.author: Joe M.
reviews.quote: John did a great job repairing our ceiling plaster with minimal hassle
reviews.analysis: Ceiling plaster repair described as low-disruption. Supports capability on plaster ceilings in occupied homes; “minimal hassle” is a customer's characterisation, not a measured dust, noise or access outcome.

reviews.author: Karl W.
reviews.quote: John did a great job adding a veneer plaster to a newly drywalled ceiling. He was easy to communicate with, friendly, and took great care of the space. The finish of the ceiling was amazing, he truly is a pro. Highly recommended.
reviews.analysis: Shows veneer plaster applied over new drywall on a ceiling — the exact combination needed when a modern drywall patch meets an older plaster ceiling. “Took great care of the space” is relevant to working above an occupied unit but is one customer's account.

reviews.author: John L.
reviews.quote: John did great work patching several interior and exterior holes made by an electrician. He took extra care to set up and clean up to avoid making a mess. I would recommend.
reviews.analysis: Patching holes left behind by another trade, with deliberate set-up and clean-up. That is the same coordination pattern as closing an opening made for a plumber, and the containment comment is the most relevant detail in wave 6 for work above an occupied unit.

reviews.author: Eric S.
reviews.quote: Really great work repairing our plaster wall around a heater. Almost doesn't needs painting
reviews.analysis: Repair around an existing penetration with a finish close enough that painting was nearly unnecessary. Supports finish-matching skill on plaster; the excerpt is a wall, not a ceiling, and the reviewer's grammar is reproduced as published.

reviews.author: Not reliably resolved in extract
reviews.quote: His lath and plaster pass the city inspection with no problems.
reviews.analysis: The single most compliance-relevant sentence found in wave 6: a customer states that this business's lath and plaster work passed city inspection. It is an unattributed excerpt with no visible date, it does not name the inspection type, and a customer's account of an inspection is not an official inspection record.
